abstract: A connected triangle-free graph on 448 vertices, G(14,18), has Inverse Even 40049/4444 when Even(v) counts v itself, and exactly nine distinct distance eigenvalues under a verified invariant-subspace decomposition. Whether those two exact values stand in the relation Graffiti 322 forbids depends on two contested readings of the conjecture, and this report enumerates them rather than choosing between them: each reading pair is carried as a record with its own exact verdict, alongside a replay of the previously published C4 candidate under the same four readings. Novelty and significance are not assessed.

end AdaIvyPhase3B

derivation.summary: Construct G(r,t) by replacing every edge of K(r) with a length-three path and attaching t leaves at each branch vertex. Classify the even-distance counts exactly, verify the supplied invariant-subspace decomposition against the graph's own distance matrix, and compare the exact rational Inverse Even value with the distinct eigenvalue count.

claims.prose_statement: The connected triangle-free graph G(14,18) has Inverse Even 40049/4444 and exactly nine distinct distance eigenvalues, so under the enumerated reading (even_includes_v, range_distinct_count) it is a candidate counterexample to Graffiti 322. Under the range_extent reading of the same conjecture it is not, and the previously published C4 candidate is a candidate under (even_excludes_v, range_distinct_count). Which reading is the source's is not decided here.

readings.statement: Even(v) is the set of vertices at even distance from v and includes v itself, because distance zero is even. This is the reading AdaIvy froze for the Graffiti 322 report. No transcription of the defining page is recorded, so the reading is asserted rather than re-extractable.
Even(v) is the set of vertices other than v at even distance from v, so v itself is not counted. This is the reading under which the previously published C4 candidate refutes Graffiti 322.
The range of the distance spectrum is the number of distinct distance eigenvalues. The Graffiti 197 prior-resolution record is filed under this same meaning of range.
The range of the distance spectrum is the extent lambda_max minus lambda_min. Under this meaning the G(14,18) evaluation does not refute Graffiti 322 at all.

runs.v: Two terms of the conjecture are contested. Whether Even(v) counts v itself, and whether the range of the distance spectrum is the number of distinct distance eigenvalues or the extent of the spectrum, are enumerated as a convention record with one verdict per reading rather than settled in this prose. The verdict for each reading is an exact evaluation, not a judgement about what the source meant.

sections.title: Statement and the readings it depends on

runs.v: A previously published candidate for the same conjecture is C4. Its witness was replayed by this repository's own exact engine under all four enumerated readings rather than read off the prior paper's reported numbers: it refutes under one reading and not under the other three. The prior-art classification that records this comparison is bound to the same reading set.

A bounded pre-research literature search over the acquired corpus returned an inconclusive outcome, and a second, result-specific prior art classification was performed after the construction existed. Both are records in this bundle, and neither establishes that no earlier refutation exists.

The reading on which the headline evaluation rests has never been re-extracted from the 2004 compilation, priority against the earlier candidate is reading-dependent and undecided, and no human has checked the 448-vertex derivation. Each of those is an open obligation in the table below rather than a sentence here.

verdicts.detail: InvEven(G(14,18)) = 8772568/953095 also exceeds 9, so excluding v from Even(v) does not change the outcome for this witness.
The same exact bound settles the extent reading for the exclude-v value.
InvEven(G(14,18)) = 40049/4444 exceeds the 9 distinct distance eigenvalues returned by the verified invariant-subspace decomposition, so the witness refutes under this reading.
The exact Rayleigh bound 2W/n = 32915/16 already exceeds InvEven, so the spectral extent is strictly greater and the witness refutes nothing under this reading.
